messages:
sam_k: quick ping — can someone take a look at my TF PR that wires peering between gpu-pool-vpc and shared-services? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1423 Need to merge before tomorrow's staging deploy. :eyes:
irene: :eyes: is this going to touch prod routing or just staging?
sam_k: staging workspace only for now. we'll validate there then promote. main risks are route propagation timing and the peer accept step (the other account needs to accept the peering).
alex: can you paste the plan excerpt for the added routes so I can check for any overlapping CIDR or accidental 0.0.0.0/0 adds?
sam_k: plan snippet below — no deletes, just creates for peering and routes:
```hcl
# added resources
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "gpu_shared" {
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-0a1b2c3d"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.gpu_pool.id
}
resource "aws_route" "to_shared" {
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.gpu_private.id
  destination_cidr_block = "10.100.0.0/16"
  vpc_peering_connection_id = aws_vpc_peering_connection.gpu_shared.id
}
```
sam_k: plan summary: +1 aws_vpc_peering_connection.gpu_shared, +2 aws_route.*. No changes to existing route tables beyond additions.
maria: happy to review now — giving it a quick pass, will leave comments in the PR. :+1:
raj: quick checklist: ensure tfstate locking is enabled on the staging workspace; run `terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan` and validate with `terraform show -json plan.tfplan | jq '.resource_changes[] | select(.change.actions | index("create"))'` to inspect created resources programmatically. Also confirm provider versions.
alex: LGTM on the route entries from this snippet, but confirm the peer owner will accept the peering on their side — otherwise routes will be blackholed.
sam_k: good call — I've filed NET-879 and pinged the networking folks to accept. acceptance is manual in their account. If networking confirms, I can merge after maria's review and one more +1.
deploy-bot: Heads up — staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC. Merges after 2026-03-17 23:00 UTC will be included. :alarm_clock:
maria: left one minor comment about SG rules (restricting SSH from jumpbox). otherwise :+1:
irene: ok thanks — tagging @networking to confirm acceptance step.
networking: noted, we'll accept once we verify no CIDR overlap and once ops confirms temporary routing rules. will update NET-879 with ETA. :white_check_mark:
